column2:
<Cless>:<nl>
 Do you know the Tale of the Spirit?
<pause>
Sailor:<nl>
 Oh yeah, Grandma told me that one
 all the time as a tyke.
<pause>
Sailor:<nl>
 Once upon a time, there were no
 monsters--
<pause>
<Cless>:<nl>
 Wait, I know the beginning.
<pause>
<Cless>:<nl>
 What happens hundreds of years
 after the poison was spread
 around the world?
<pause>
Sailor:<nl>
 Oh, let me see...
<pause>
Sailor:<nl>
 After those many generations, the
 people beneath the barrier began
 to forget why it had been created
 in the first place.
<pause>
Sailor:<nl>
 They began to get superstitious,
 and believed there was nothing
 beyond but an endless,
 all-consuming abyss.
<pause>
Sailor:<nl>
 Any thought of venturing out and
 returning was considered
 inconceivable.
<pause>
Sailor:<nl>
 Hundreds more years passed, and a
 young soldier, quite allegiant to his
 nation, appeared.
<pause>
Sailor:<nl>
 One day, he went to investigate the
 ruins that lie beneath the ground.
<pause>
Sailor:<nl>
 He found something spectacular:
 the Spirit of the Moon.
<pause>
Sailor:<nl>
 He was instantly smitten by her
 incomparable beauty.
<pause>
Sailor:<nl>
 His heart stolen, the soldier fell in
 love with her.
<pause>
Sailor:<nl>
 However, the king disapproved of
 this, and attempted once again to
 confine the spirit.
<pause>
Sailor:<nl>
 He wanted her power for his own
 ends.
<pause>
Sailor:<nl>
 And, uhhh... I don't remember
 anything after that.{END}

Sailor:<nl>
 Whenever I gaze out over the
 endless, deep blue sea, I start to
 feel like a kid again.{END}

column1:
<audio_1B0B>テン
「まさか、
　きみエクリプスかい？」
<pause>
<audio_1B0C>ロンドリーネ
「ううん、
　そうじゃないけど・・・
　そうだっていうか・・・」
<pause>
<audio_1B0D>テン
「なんだ、そりゃ」
<pause>
<audio_1B0E>ロンドリーネ
「君、エクリプスのこと、
　詳しいの？」
<pause>
<audio_1B0F>テン
「そうだなぁ・・・
　噂で気になって、色々客に
　聞いたり調べたりしたんだ」
<pause>
<audio_1B10>テン
「オヤジは教えてくれないしさ
　でもまだ知ってるほうだけど、
　そんな詳しいわけじゃない」
<pause>
<audio_1B11>テン
「それでもいいのか？」
<pause>
<audio_1B12>ロンドリーネ
「それでもかまわない。一族の
　ことを少しでも知れるなら」
<pause>
<audio_1B13>テン
「オレの知ってることって
　言えば・・・」
<pause>
<audio_1B14>テン
「エクリプスってのは世界の裏側
　から勢力バランスをとっている
　組織らしいってことかな」
<pause>
<audio_1B15>テン
「力が強くなりすぎた国を混乱に
　陥れたり、強い力を持ったら、
　その元を潰したり、ね」{END}
column2:
<audio_1B0B>Ten:<nl>
Don't tell me... Are you with the Eclipse?
<pause>
<audio_1B0C>Rondoline:<nl>
No, I'm not with them, but...<nl>
Well, maybe? I dunno...
<pause>
<audio_1B0D>Ten:<nl>
The hell?
<pause>
<audio_1B0E>Rondoline:<nl>
How much do you know about Eclipse?
<pause>
<audio_1B0F>Ten:<nl>
Hmm... The stories about it fascinated me,
so I asked all sorts of customers about it.
<pause>
<audio_1B10>Ten:<nl>
Though, the old man never mentioned them.
I can only tell you what I know, even though it's not a whole lot.
<pause>
<audio_1B11>Ten:<nl>
That fine with you?
<pause>
<audio_1B12>Rondoline:<nl>
Sounds good to me. As long as I can
learn even a little about my family.
<pause>
<audio_1B13>Ten:<nl>
Well, here's what I know...
<pause>
<audio_1B14>Ten:<nl>
Long story short, the Eclipse is an organization that maintains the balance of the world from the shadows.
<pause>
<audio_1B15>Ten:<nl>
They say if any country amasses too much power, the organization plunges them into chaos and destroys their very foundation.{END}

column1:

<audio_1B1B>テン

column2:
<audio_1B16>Rondoline:<nl>

<pause>

<audio_1B18>Ten:<nl>

<pause>
<audio_1B19>Ten:<nl>

<pause>
<audio_1B1A>Ten:<nl>
And above all, they're an organization that prioritizes recruiting those skilled at assassination.
<pause>
<audio_1B1B>Ten:<nl>
As for where they are and what they're doing now? That I don't know.
<pause>
<audio_1B1C>Ten:<nl>
I've heard theories that they might be living normally in town amongst ordinary folk; or deep within the mountains.{END}

column2:
<audio_1B1D>Rondoline:<nl>

<audio_1B1E>Ten:<nl>

<pause>
<audio_1B1F>Ten:<nl>

<pause>
<audio_1B20>Rondoline:<nl>
That's so vague...
<pause>
<audio_1B21>Ten:<nl>
They're fraught with rumors for good reason.
<pause>
<audio_1B22>Ten:<nl>
Only a few people in this world truly know the means to reach out to them.
<pause>
<audio_1B23>Ten:<nl>
Heck, what I'm saying may or may NOT be true.
<pause>
<audio_1B24>Ten:<nl>
To be honest, I didn't believe the Eclipse existed at all until I saw you walk in with Dragunov.
<pause>
<audio_1B25>Ten:<nl>
The only one I know who has met them
in person is old man Aegis.
<pause>
<audio_1B26>Rondoline:<nl>
I see... So that's how it is... Thank you.{END}
